A darker landmine girl story this time.
Support the artist if you liked it: https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ437938.html

Story:
College student Shōji Sagara had come to an abandoned building with two friends for a dare.
After getting separated from his friends, he was exploring the ruins when he heard a woman’s voice…
Tentatively entering the room where the voice was coming from, he encountered a girl named Amika Hazuki, who had attempted suicide.
Amika, who had become desperate, took his playful, suggestive remark at face value...
n: [Doujinshi] [parapluie (Ameno Shigure)] A story about having sex all night with a landmine girl in an abandoned ruin
